arena.title: Model Arena
arena.body: Three opinions on each season: the rule engine, a machine-learning model and the satellites. Agreement means you can lean on it.
arena.loading: Asking the three methods about every season…
arena.empty.title: Not enough data for the Arena yet
arena.empty.body: The Arena needs at least one full season of daily weather. It appears once the field's data loads.
arena.matrix.title: Season by season
arena.matrix.caption: How the three methods rate each season, and how much they agree
arena.matrix.score: On average the methods agree {score} of the time. 100% means they always give the same answer.
arena.matrix.noScore: Fewer than two methods have an answer for this season, so there is nothing to compare yet.
arena.season.title: Season {season} in detail
arena.season.score: For this season the three methods agree {score} of the time.
arena.rule.title: Rule engine
arena.rule.body: Water stress of your current rotation this season: {stress}, from the daily water balance.
arena.rule.none: The comparison has not replayed this season for your current rotation.
arena.ml.title: ML model
arena.ml.body: Expected greenness at the peak of the season: {z} (a score against a typical season; below zero is poorer).
arena.ml.unavailable: The ML model is not available right now, so only two opinions are compared.
arena.ml.no-weather: The weather record does not cover January to June of this season, so the model cannot be asked.
arena.sat.title: Satellites
arena.sat.ndvi: Peak greenness seen from space: {peak}, which is {z} against your field's other seasons.
arena.sat.noNdvi: Not enough satellite greenness readings to compare this season with the others.
arena.sat.smap: Root-zone soil moisture was {z} against your field's other seasons.
arena.sat.noSmap: No soil moisture anomaly for this season.
arena.flags.title: Where the methods disagree
arena.flags.body: These notes also appear as risks on the rotation cards. They call for a local check, not a decision.
arena.flags.none: No season has one method seeing strong stress while another sees a normal season.
arena.flag.ruleMl: {season}: the rules see water stress, the ML model expects a normal season. Treat the stress call as uncertain.
arena.flag.mlRule: {season}: the ML model expects stress, the rules see little. Treat the season as uncertain.
arena.flag.ruleSat: {season}: rules see water stress, satellites saw normal greenness. Irrigation, data or a tolerant crop may explain it; check locally.
arena.flag.satRule: {season}: greenness fell but the rules see little water stress. Frost, pests or management may be why; check locally.
arena.flag.mlSat: {season}: the ML model expects stress, satellites saw normal greenness. Irrigation or data may explain it; check locally.
arena.flag.satMl: {season}: greenness fell but the ML model saw normal weather. Pests or management may be involved; check locally.
arena.honest: The ML model is an experimental second opinion trained on winter cereals. It predicts greenness, not yield.
compare.toArena: See how the three methods rate each season
